title: mariscus ovularis
intro: Mariscus ovularis, commonly known as Round-leaved Sedge, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the sedge family (Cyperaceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which can aid in soothing digestive issues, reducing pain, and enhancing immune function. The therapeutic actions of Mariscus ovularis include analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and expectorant properties, making it a potential treatment for respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
